events.title: Noël Acadien au Village
events.desc:
Lafayette's big Christmas lights festival: about half a million lights across the Acadian Village, including the lit-up chapel, plus holiday displays, live music, carnival rides, local food, photos with Santa and the Christmas Store.

Tickets: $10 in advance at area ShopRite stores, $11 online (plus a fee) or $12 at the gate. Kids 2 and under get in free.

It's a fundraiser for LARC, a Lafayette nonprofit that supports people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Dates here are from LARC's 2026 announcements; check the village's website or Facebook page for weather closures.
